modes.after-write: project root = the variant (the agent has written the change, then calls check_diff on git diff)
modes.before-write: project root = the clean project (the agent checks a proposed diff before writing it)
modes.spec-only: no project root (spec-only: new files whole, modified files on their added lines)

limits.reason: A cycle is a property of the whole import graph. Without a project root the fast path sees only the changed files, so it cannot close a cycle (no-cyclic-deps is listed in notChecked).

Without a project root a modified file is checked on its added lines only. A class-level fact (here a value object made mutable by an added setter or field) is a fact about the class declaration, and the added lines alone do not parse as one, so the member facts cannot be read.
